LESSON: SELF-EXPRESSION

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Self-expression

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Self-expression. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Express own needs at home and at school.
2. Express emotions and feelings appropriately at home and at school.
3. Use appropriate vocabulary to express feelings and emotions in school and at home.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Express own needs at home and at school.

2. Express emotions and feelings appropriately at home and at school.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Self-expression.
2. Explain Self-expression to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self-expression.
4. Show that you can: Express own needs at home and at school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self-expression. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Self-expression important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
